def matches(a,b):
 try: compare(a,b); return True
 except AssertionError: return False
def differences(a,b,path='root'):
 if isinstance(a,dict) and isinstance(b,dict):
  for k in sorted(a.keys()-b.keys()): yield path+'.'+k,a[k],'<ABSENT>'
  for k in sorted(b.keys()-a.keys()): yield path+'.'+k,'<ABSENT>',b[k]
  for k in a.keys()&b.keys(): yield from differences(a[k],b[k],path+'.'+k)
 elif isinstance(a,list) and isinstance(b,list):
  if len(a)!=len(b): yield path+'.length',len(a),len(b)
  for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,b)): yield from differences(x,y,f'{path}[{i}]')
 elif not matches(a,b): yield path,a,b
def summarize(a,b):
 groups={}
 for path,x,y in differences(a,b):
  key=re.sub(r'\[\d+\]','[]',path)
  g=groups.setdefault(key,dict(count=0,examples=[]))
  g['count']+=1
  if len(g['examples'])<2:
   e=dict(path=path,baseline=x,candidate=y)
   try:
    delta=float(y)-float(x);e['absolute_difference']=abs(delta)
    e['relative_difference']=abs(delta)/abs(float(x)) if float(x) else None
   except (TypeError,ValueError):pass
   g['examples'].append(e)
 return groups
cases=[]

 case=dict(id=raw['id'],raw_harness_status=raw['status'],raw_error=raw.get('error'),

    if q.suffix in ('.csv','.jsonl') or q.name=='system_metrics.json'}
 if len(artifacts)!=2:
  case['classification']='RUN_OR_ARTIFACT_FAILURE';cases.append(case);continue
 a,b=artifacts['baseline'],artifacts['candidate']
 case['added_artifacts']=sorted(b.keys()-a.keys())
 case['removed_artifacts']=sorted(a.keys()-b.keys())
 for key in sorted(a.keys()|b.keys()):
  x,y=a.get(key),b.get(key)
  entry={'baseline_path':str(dirs['baseline']/key),'candidate_path':str(dirs['candidate']/key),
         'baseline_rows':len(x) if isinstance(x,list) else None,'candidate_rows':len(y) if isinstance(y,list) else None}
  if key not in a: entry['comparison']='ADDED_ARTIFACT'
  elif key not in b: entry['comparison']='REMOVED_ARTIFACT'
  elif matches(x,y):entry['comparison']='EXACT_VALUES' if x==y else 'COMPARATOR_MATCH'
  else:entry.update(comparison='DIFFERENT',differences=summarize(x,y))
  case['artifacts'][key]=entry
 reqa,reqb=a['request_metrics.csv'],b['request_metrics.csv']
 discrete_names=[k for k in reqa[0] if k=='Request Id' or k.startswith(('request_num_','request_spec_','request_total_preemption','request_prefill_preemption','request_decode_preemption','request_thinking_round','request_session','request_cohort'))]
 case['request_exact_common_columns']=[k for k in reqa[0] if [r[k] for r in reqa]==[r[k] for r in reqb]]
 case['request_numeric_changed_columns']=[k for k in reqa[0] if not matches([r[k] for r in reqa],[r[k] for r in reqb])]
 case['request_discrete_fields']=discrete_names
 case['request_discrete_match']=matches([{k:r[k] for k in discrete_names} for r in reqa],[{k:r[k] for k in discrete_names} for r in reqb])
 cfg=json.loads((dirs['candidate']/'config.json').read_text())
 rc=cfg['cluster_config']['replica_config'];n=rc['model_config']['num_layers']//rc['num_pipeline_stages']
 inv=json.loads((root/raw['id']/'candidate'/'invocation.json').read_text())
 dummy=float(inv['environment_overrides']['DUMMY_EXEC_TIME_MS'])
 ep=b.get('frontier_ep_wave_lane_ledger.jsonl',[])
 ep_errors=[]
 for i,row in enumerate(ep):
  phases=row['phases'];s=sum(p['duration_ms'] for p in phases.values())

  for name,p in phases.items():
   if not matches(sum(p['operators_ms'].values()),p['duration_ms']):
    ep_errors.append(dict(row=i,check='phase operator sum',phase=name))
  if any(type(v)!=int or not 0<=v<rc['model_config']['num_layers'] for v in row['global_layer_ids']):
   ep_errors.append(dict(row=i,check='global layer domain'))
 groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
 for row in ep:
  key=(row['cluster'],row['replica_id'],row['stage_id'],tuple(row['global_layer_ids']),row['wave_start_time_s'],row['wave_end_time_s'])
  groups[key].append(row)
 for key,peers in groups.items():
  phase_names=('pre_dispatch','dispatch','routed_compute','combine','post_combine')
  phase_max={name:max(r['phases'][name]['duration_ms'] for r in peers) for name in phase_names}
  observed=(key[-1]-key[-2])*1000
  if not matches(sum(phase_max.values()),observed):
   ep_errors.append(dict(check='wave phase barrier maxima',wave=key,expected=sum(phase_max.values()),actual=observed))
  cursor=key[-2]
  for name in phase_names:
   if any(not matches(r['phases'][name]['start_time_s'],cursor) for r in peers):
    ep_errors.append(dict(check='shared phase starts',wave=key,phase=name))
   cursor+=phase_max[name]*1e-3
 case['ep_artifact_oracle']=dict(rows=len(ep),errors=ep_errors[:15],error_count=len(ep_errors),wave_groups=len(groups),checks=['phase operator sums','wave duration equals sum of peer phase maxima','shared phase starts','global layer domain'])
 la,lb=a['frontier_stage_batch_ledger.jsonl'],b['frontier_stage_batch_ledger.jsonl']
 attn_names=('attention_all_reduce_time','attention_decode_execution_time','attention_kv_cache_save_execution_time','attention_post_proj_time','attention_pre_proj_time','attention_prefill_execution_time','attention_rope_execution_time','attn_norm_time')
 host_names=('prepare_inputs_e2e_time','process_model_outputs_time','ray_comm_time','sampler_e2e_time','schedule_time','pipeline_parallel_communication_time')
 checked=[]
 for i,row in enumerate(lb):
  if row['execution_scope']!='ATTN_DP_LANE' or not ep:continue
  comp=row['execution_time']['component_ledger_ms'];expected={k:dummy*n if comp[k] else 0 for k in attn_names}
  expected.update({k:dummy if comp[k] else 0 for k in host_names})
  errs=[dict(field=k,expected=v,actual=comp[k]) for k,v in expected.items() if not matches(v,comp[k])]
  component_sum=sum(comp.values());total=row['execution_time']['total_time_ms']
  if not matches(component_sum,total):errs.append(dict(field='component_sum',expected=component_sum,actual=total))
  waves=[e for e in ep if e['cluster']==row['cluster_type'] and e['stage_id']==row['stage_id'] and row['batch_id'] in e['source_batch_ids']]
  by_layer={}
  for e in waves:
   for layer in e['global_layer_ids']:
    by_layer[layer]=max(by_layer.get(layer,0),sum(p['duration_ms'] for p in e['phases'].values()))
  predicted_ms=total+sum(by_layer.values())
  observed_ms=(row['stage_end_ts']-row['stage_start_ts'])*1000
  check=dict(row=i,cluster=row['cluster_type'],batch=row['batch_id'],expected_layers=n,
      independent_components=expected,component_oracle_errors=errs,
      physical_layer_coverage=sorted(by_layer),ep_critical_ms=sum(by_layer.values()),
      candidate_stage_expected_ms=predicted_ms,candidate_stage_observed_ms=observed_ms,
      stage_span_match=matches(predicted_ms,observed_ms))
  if i<len(la) and all(la[i].get(k)==row.get(k) for k in ('batch_id','cluster_type','request_ids')):
   base=la[i];baseobs=(base['stage_end_ts']-base['stage_start_ts'])*1000
   predicted_base=(predicted_ms-sum(comp[k] for k in host_names))/n+sum(comp[k] for k in host_names) if row['cluster_type'] in ('PREFILL','DECODE') else predicted_ms
   check.update(baseline_stage_expected_ms=predicted_base,baseline_stage_observed_ms=baseobs,baseline_scope_oracle_match=matches(predicted_base,baseobs))
  checked.append(check)
 case['stage_oracles']=checked
 baseline_oracles=[]
 for i,row in enumerate(la):
  if row['execution_scope']!='ATTN_DP_LANE' or not ep:continue
  candidates=[x for x in checked if x['cluster']==row['cluster_type']]
  values={round(x['candidate_stage_expected_ms'],9) for x in candidates}

  observed_ms=(row['stage_end_ts']-row['stage_start_ts'])*1000
  baseline_oracles.append(dict(row=i,cluster=row['cluster_type'],independent_expected_ms=expected_ms,observed_ms=observed_ms,match=matches(expected_ms,observed_ms)))
 case['baseline_stage_oracles']=baseline_oracles
 request_role=[]
 if ep:
  for side,rows,reqs in [('baseline',la,reqa),('candidate',lb,reqb)]:
   for req in reqs:
    rid=req['Request Id']

     owned=[x for x in rows if x['cluster_type']==role and rid in x['request_ids']]

 case['request_role_stage_sum_oracles']=request_role
 if raw['id'] in ('pdd_online_moe_model_basic_chunked','pd-af-disagg_online_moe_model_basic_chunked'):
  arrival=min(x['stage_start_ts'] for x in la)
  arrivals={}

   if j:arrival+=float(r['request_inter_arrival_delay'])
   arrivals[r['Request Id']]=arrival
  batching={}
  for side,rows in [('baseline',la),('candidate',lb)]:
   pre=[x for x in rows if x['cluster_type']=='PREFILL']
   tokens=collections.Counter()
   for x in pre:
    tokens.update(dict(zip(x['request_ids'],x['request_num_prefill_tokens'])))
   batching[side]=dict(role_row_counts=dict(collections.Counter(x['cluster_type'] for x in rows)),
     prefill_token_totals=dict(tokens),prefill_batches=[dict(batch_id=x['batch_id'],start_s=x['stage_start_ts'],end_s=x['stage_end_ts'],request_ids=x['request_ids'],prefill_tokens=x['request_num_prefill_tokens']) for x in pre],
     arrivals_ready_at_second_prefill=[rid for rid,t in arrivals.items() if t<=pre[1]['stage_start_ts']],
     all_scheduled_after_arrival=all(arrivals[rid]<=x['stage_start_ts'] for x in pre for rid in x['request_ids']))
  case['changed_batching_evidence']=dict(request_arrivals_s=arrivals,**batching)
  case['changed_batching_evidence']['token_conservation_match']=batching['baseline']['prefill_token_totals']==batching['candidate']['prefill_token_totals']=={r['Request Id']:int(r['request_num_prefill_tokens']) for r in reqa}

 case['oracle_failures']=(sum(bool(x['component_oracle_errors']) or not x['stage_span_match'] or x['physical_layer_coverage']!=list(range(n)) for x in checked)
  +sum(not x['match'] for x in baseline_oracles)+sum(not x['match'] for x in request_role)+len(ep_errors))
 reqmatch=case['artifacts']['request_metrics.csv']['comparison'] in ('EXACT_VALUES','COMPARATOR_MATCH')
 sysmatch=case['artifacts']['system_metrics.json']['comparison'] in ('EXACT_VALUES','COMPARATOR_MATCH')
 case['classification']=('RAW_COMPARATOR_PASS' if raw['status']=='PASS' else
  'D01_STAGE_REPORTING_AND_EP_ARTIFACT' if reqmatch and sysmatch else
  'D01_UNIFORM_LAYER_DUMMY_CORRECTION_WITH_NUMERIC_DIFFERENCES')
 case['stage_row_counts']={'baseline':len(la),'candidate':len(lb)}
 cases.append(case)

 comparator={'source':'tests/integration/run_scheduler_refactor_fidelity.py','rel_tol':1e-12,'abs_tol':1e-9,'unchanged':True},
 raw_totals=dict(collections.Counter(r['status'] for r in results)),cases=cases)

 source_diff='/data/ycfeng/tmp/pr33-w10-final-source-2.diff',cases=[])

 row=dict(id=case['id'],artifacts={})

 recheck['cases'].append(row)

third_check['all_comparator_matches']=all(x['comparator_match'] for r in third_check['cases'] for x in r['artifacts'].values())

out['third_campaign_recheck']=third_check
out['latest_campaign']=str(third)
out['latest_source_commit']=third_manifest['revisions']['candidate']
print('THIRD', {k:v for k,v in third_check.items() if k not in ('cases','raw_results','manifest')})
Path('/data/ycfeng/tmp/pr33-w10-fidelity-classification.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print('COMPLETE',out['complete'],'RAW',out['raw_totals'])
